g.text: Import chain (gontroller): walk -> group -> gate -> identify -> exif -> commit;
every participant is a step (own goroutine), every arrow is a channel (closed when its writers are done)
identify: the item known (exiftool lives here)
exif: the EXIF perceptors, their values kept
files flow in; groups flow out one by one, steps run concurrently
a new chain, Process: a pass starts the entry
page by page: new rows created, changed stats saved
first file: asset links from Photos.sqlite
(original, render, Live Photo video); buffer of open
groups, a group goes out when all its files arrived
a whole asset (keyed by its UUID); the files of an
asset trashed / hidden in Photos: missing
[nobody else claims it (other providers: Immich, ... later)]
sidecars by name, next to each other
(buffer: one open group; a complete group goes out)
a provider not enabled is not asked:
its files are a plain folder's
the model's Gone: a main file's item deleted,
[changed (stat, a role the grouper gave) / needs work (Rework, ...)]
ONE exiftool -j call for the group (only the declared tags);
kind of every file (exif MIMEType, own extension table, sniff),
the main file first, roles; the metadata package (the source >
.xmp > main > derivatives; only the perceptors' tags);
the main file's fingerprint: size + sha256(first, last 64 KB)
not media / broken: ignored; else by path and
what the browser shows now, no transcode:
Show / the main file (JPEG, PNG, ...; H.264 video) /
the biggest viewable derivative / the main file's embedded
preview (exiftool -b into the cache); any size counts
+ date, size, length (written into the item)
a row in every import perceptor's storage
items at once. Ready comes later from
[every row the walk did not see that it says is missing (V2: a complete walk,
under the root, not under unreadable directories)]
the file, missing: to its library's grouper,
which passes it through or makes something of it
the walk returns: its channel CLOSES
the switch returns: every grouper's input closes
returns (an incomplete group waits for the next walk)
the gate's input closes once every grouper has returned
(a WaitGroup per channel); so on, step by step, to the end
every group of the walk went through every step
rescan pause (1 min), then the next pass
One asset again (Apple Photos on demand)
Photos made a file of an asset local
the Apple library marks the item for rework
(updated_at untouched: no delta brings the item back)
no waiting: the client guesses meanwhile
(the tile's cloud goes once it got the original)
